# University of Lagos (UNILAG) Admission Requirements 2025/2026

The University of Lagos (UNILAG) announces admission requirements for the 2025/2026 academic session.

## General Admission Requirements

UTME Cut-off Mark: 200

**O-Level Requirements:** Five (5) credits including English Language, Mathematics, and three other relevant subjects at not more than two (2) sittings.

**Post-UTME:** Screening exercise required. Format: Computer-based test. Weight: 30% of aggregate.

**Aggregate Formula:** (UTME/8) + (Post-UTME/2) + (O-Level/2)

## Faculties

The University of Lagos has the following faculties:
- Arts
- Basic Medical Sciences
- Business Administration
- Clinical Sciences
- Dental Sciences
- Education
- Engineering
- Environmental Sciences
- Law
- Pharmacy
- Science
- Social Sciences

## Programmes Offered

- Medicine and Surgery (MBBS) - 6 years
- Computer Science (B.Sc) - 4 years
- Law (LL.B) - 5 years
- Accounting (B.Sc) - 4 years
- Mass Communication (B.Sc) - 4 years
- Electrical Engineering (B.Eng) - 5 years
- Mechanical Engineering (B.Eng) - 5 years
- Civil Engineering (B.Eng) - 5 years
- Pharmacy (B.Pharm) - 5 years

| Course | Merit | Catchment | ELDS |
|--------|-------|-----------|------|
| Medicine and Surgery | 280 | 270 | 260 |
| Computer Science | 240 | 230 | 220 |
| Law | 250 | 240 | 230 |
| Accounting | 220 | 210 | 200 |
| Electrical Engineering | 230 | 220 | 210 |

## School Fees (2025/2026)

**Tuition:**
- Indigene: NGN 126,325 per session
- Non-indigene: NGN 150,000 per session

**Other Fees:**
- Application fee: NGN 2,000
- Acceptance fee: NGN 50,000
- Hostel accommodation: NGN 35,000 per session

## Catchment Areas

The University of Lagos operates the ELDS states catchment policy. The following 21 states are covered:
Adamawa, Bauchi, Bayelsa, Benue, Borno, Cross River, Gombe, Jigawa, Kaduna, Kano, Katsina, Kebbi, Kogi, Kwara, Nasarawa, Niger, Plateau, Rivers, Sokoto, Taraba, Yobe.

Lagos State indigenes also receive special consideration.

## Direct Entry Requirements

Candidates with the following qualifications are eligible for Direct Entry:
- A-Level (minimum B grade in relevant subjects)
- ND (minimum Upper Credit)
- HND (minimum Lower Credit)
- JUPEB (minimum 12 points in relevant subjects)
- IJMB (minimum 10 points in relevant subjects)

## Application Portal

Apply online at https://admissions.unilag.edu.ng

## Important Dates

- Application opens: January 15, 2026
- Application closes: April 30, 2026
- Post-UTME screening: July 2026
- Resumption: September 2026
